subject: Geo allowance — granular country adjustments and pilot proposal
messages:
From: Remy Gonzalez <remy@growthbench.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Geo allowance fine-grain proposal for leveling

Hi Markus / Laura / Tessa,

Thanks for the background call last week. Attached is a short proposal for moving from broad "geo bands" to a more granular country-level allowance model that preserves internal leveling while improving competitiveness in LATAM and APAC.

High level:
- Replace 3-band (low/mid/high) multipliers with country-level % adjustments derived from market data and compensation anchors.
- Keep level base ranges unchanged; apply country adjustment as a separate line on offers so we can track delta.
- Exempt equity calculations initially; include in phase 2.

Attachments:
- RBW_geo_allowance_methodology_2027.pdf (methodology + sample dataset)

Questions for you:
1) Should the allowance be visible on offer letters or normalized into base for certain countries? (compliance + candidate experience trade-off)
2) Which markets do you want to pilot first (we recommend MX, BR, IN, SG)?
3) Any constraints on currency rounding or payroll system limits we should know about?

Next steps: if you confirm pilot markets I can deliver a pilot run and a headcount/cost impact spreadsheet by EOD Monday.

Best,
Remy
GrowthBench Consulting
Attachment: RBW_geo_allowance_methodology_2027.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Geo allowance fine-grain proposal for leveling

Remy — thanks for the quick work and clear deck.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We prefer to surface the country allowance on offers for transparency, but if local payroll/legal pushes back we'll fold it into base on a per-country basis. Please include both variants in the pilot outputs.
- Pilot markets: agree with MX, BR, IN. Add PH (Philippines) instead of SG — SG's payroll/comms is straightforward; PH is where we see more offer friction.
- Currency rounding: finance requires rounding to the nearest 100 in MX/MXN and nearest 10 in INR.

Can you produce:
- Pilot headcount impact by team (IC vs manager) with monthly and annualized $delta
- A short FAQ that we can share with recruiters explaining the allowance rationale and how to communicate it to candidates

Looping in Karthik for approval on piloting scope.

Subject: Re: Geo allowance fine-grain proposal for leveling — pilot suggestion

Markus / team — reviewed Remy's deck overnight. A couple of practical points from Talent Ops:

- Visibility: We should surface the allowance on offer letters for transparency in LATAM; for APAC (IN/PH) we should test both visible and embedded options because local candidate expectations differ.
- Payroll constraints: Philippines payroll does accept separate allowance lines, but some local providers bill in USD — we need to validate with local payroll partners to avoid tax misclassification.
- Equity: For the pilot, exclude equity as Remy suggested. We'll revisit after Q2.

Pilot proposal (operational):
- Duration: 8 weeks
- Markets: MX, BR, IN, PH
- Teams: Core Platform (IC heavy) + Growth (mix of IC and managers)
- Deliverables: headcount/cost impact spreadsheet, recruiter FAQ, offer template snippets

I've attached a draft spreadsheet with an initial headcount delta by team:
- pilot_headcount_impact_2027.xlsx (contains sample runs at 2,5,10% adoption)

Couple of asks before we kick off:
- Please include an annualized headcount/cost impact and a monthly-run rate so finance can surface the numbers to the Budget Review board.
- Keep pilot to no more than 50 hires to limit mid-year budget variance; if we see upside we can expand in Q3.
